name: Summary Panel
description: Shows a set of key figures at a glance.

channel.description: Widgets connected to the same channel share data (e.g. the selected deal or portfolio) between each other.
channel.title: Communication Channel

emptyStateText.description: Message shown when the scenario returns no metrics (e.g. nothing selected on the channel yet).
emptyStateText.title: Empty State Text

rowStyle.description: How each metric renders. Stacked = MetricCard style (label above a large value). Inline = MetricList style (label left, value right; denser).
rowStyle.title: Metric Row Style

schemaKey.description: Logical summary scenario resolved by GraphQL. Each scenario owns its own metric set and data source.
schemaKey.title: Schema Key

showFooter.description: Anchor an 'as of <date>' footer when the scenario supplies a date and there is vertical room (>= 240px).
showFooter.title: Show ‘as of’ Footer

titleText.description: Overrides the panel eyebrow. Leave blank to use the scenario title from GraphQL.
titleText.title: Custom Title Text
